aesthetic_principles: Monolithic Hierarchy: Vast spatial breathing room with surgical alignment grids inspired by blueprint blueprints

Editorial Tension: Asymmetric grids, massive serif display titles paired with technical monospace coordinates and precise specs

spacing_and_layout.asymmetric_bento_rules: Use 12-column grid system with offsets. Primary hero items span 8 cols, secondary visual cards span 4 cols. Maintain explicit border lines with border-[#242832] for architectural precision.

libraries: framer-motion (for scroll reveals, line masks, staggered lists, micro-interactions)

hover_effects.buttons: Brushed bronze background shift, text color lock to deep black, subtle inner glow ring expansion

testing_and_automation_requirements.rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, links, form fields, filter tabs, modal toggles, dropdowns) MUST have explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_for_implementation.file_extension_note: Ensure code files use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) extensions.
instructions_for_implementation.package_additions: Ensure lenis (@studio-freight/lenis or lenis) and framer-motion are integrated for momentum scrolling and reveal mechanics.
instructions_for_implementation.contrast_and_accessibility: Always enforce high text contrast (e.g. #F4F3EF on #0B0C0E background). Never set header dropdowns or mobile overlays to total transparent backgrounds without a solid/heavy blurred backdrop.
instructions_for_implementation.sonner_toast: Utilize sonner for enquiry form submission toast feedback.
